title: Prediction
description: A resolvable, backtestable forecast. One JSON object per line in ledger/predictions.jsonl.

statement.description: Human-readable form of the exact resolvable claim

metric.description: Named observable, e.g. 'WTI front-month settle', 'US 10y yield', 'EURUSD spot'

threshold.description: Value, or [low, high] for within_range, or event definition for event_occurs

resolution_date.description: Date on which the metric is read; horizon <= 30 days keeps forecasts short-term and testable

resolution_source.description: Named public source used to read the metric, e.g. 'CME settlement', 'FRED DGS10'

base_rate_note.description: What the unconditional base rate for this class of move is
